events.name: War Forever
events.description: Defeat Barbarian Troops to earn milestone rewards. Barbarian Troops above level 40 count as two defeats.
events.preparation: Use daily action points efficiently and coordinate stronger barbarian targets with other governors.
events.rules: Progress resets daily at 00:00 UTC; claim daily rewards before reset.

source_details.evidence: The in-game calendar bar spans August 2–3; the detail panel confirms the daily 00:00 UTC reset but does not print the overall UTC range.
source_details.review_note: Availability boundaries are represented as reset boundaries; confirm before publishing. End is exclusive.

events.name: Now or Never
events.description: Use speedup items in your city to earn milestone and ranking rewards.
events.preparation: Save building, research, training, and healing speedups for the event window.
events.rules: Only speedups used in your city earn points. The top 100 receive rank rewards.

source_details.evidence: The event panel explicitly shows UTC 2026/08/02–2026/08/03 and the remaining-time countdown resolves to the August 4 reset.
source_details.review_note: Stored end is the exclusive reset boundary following the displayed final date.

events.name: Lohar's Trial
events.description: Defeat ordinary Barbarian Troops to collect Bone Necklaces, obtain Lohar relics, and summon Lohar's troop.
events.preparation: Budget action points for barbarians. Coordinate alliance rallies for summoned Lohar troops.
events.rules: Any governor may collect event items, but an alliance is required to rally Lohar's troop.

source_details.evidence: The event panel explicitly shows UTC 2026/08/02–2026/08/03 and 06:29 remaining at approximately 17:31 UTC on August 3.
source_details.review_note: Stored end is the exclusive August 4 reset boundary.

events.name: Trial of Torgny
events.description: Challenge Chief Torgny and compete on highest damage dealt in a single challenge.
events.preparation: Governors need City Hall level 8 or higher. Plan up to five challenges per day and use the daily featured unit type.
events.rules: Torgny appears at 00:00, 06:00, 12:00, and 18:00 UTC for three hours. He cannot be rallied. Barbarian damage buffs and skills do not affect Torgny or his cohort.

source_details.evidence: The event panel explicitly shows UTC 2026/08/02–2026/08/04; the instructions state that each instance lasts three days.
source_details.review_note: Stored end is the exclusive August 5 reset boundary.
